title: Accumulator Operations Standard: Reversing Pharmacy Benefit Plan Accumulator Postings
content:
**Scope.** This standard governs reversals of deductible and out-of-pocket postings on a Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment.

## Clauses

**R1 — Reversal of a reversed or credited charge.** When a pharmacy claim, a home delivery order charge or a specialty fill charge is reversed or credited for pharmacy error, each accumulator posting made from that source record is reversed for exactly the amount originally posted, under the same source record reference, with the funding source member-paid.

**R2 — Copay-assistance back-out.** A copay-assistance back-out under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan's copay-assistance accumulator rule is a separate reversal of the same source record, with the funding source manufacturer-assistance.

**R3 — When a reversal may be posted.** A reversal may be posted only when a posting for the same source record exists on the same accumulator and no reversal with the same funding source has already been posted for it. Both facts are read from the accumulator ledger, matched on the source record, before the reversal is posted.

**R4 — Closed plan years.** Reversing a claim after the plan year has closed lowers that closed year's accumulators only while the Pharmacy Benefit Plan's accumulator correction rule allows prior-year corrections; it never touches the new plan year.

## R3 in every combination (one accumulator, one funding source)

| A posting from this source record exists on this accumulator | A reversal with this funding source already posted for it | A reversal may be posted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |

Because R3 is judged per funding source, a member-paid reversal under R1 and a manufacturer-assistance back-out under R2 of the same source record are each judged on their own.

## Illustration (hypothetical claim)

A hypothetical retail claim posted 85.00 to the deductible and 85.00 to out-of-pocket. The claim is then reversed. Under R1 the deductible is reversed by 85.00 and out-of-pocket by 85.00, each under that claim's reference and with the funding source member-paid. A second member-paid reversal of the same claim on either accumulator is not permitted under R3, since one already stands.
